_note: 유형별 묶음 구조. 같은 29번 지문이라도 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다. order/insert/irrelevant/writing 은 구조상 예외. grammar 핵심.

passage: At its core, literature stands as proof of the lasting power of human creativity and expression.
It reaches across time and space, linking us with the thoughts and feelings of people from every walk of life.
Despite new technologies and a constantly shifting media landscape, literature has kept its relevance as a timeless art form.
One reason for its enduring power is its ability to capture the complexity of human experience.
Through the written word, authors can explore deep emotions, the subtleties of relationships, and the human spirit's struggles and triumphs.
Literature lets us see ourselves in a book's pages and understand the human condition more deeply.
choices: why new technologies will soon replace printed books
why some authors write more realistically than others
how literature endures by connecting people across time and capturing human experience
how the media landscape has changed over the past century
why reading is more difficult than watching videos
theme.explanation_ko: 문학은 시공간을 넘어 사람들의 생각·감정을 잇고 인간 경험의 복잡함을 담아내며 영원한 예술로 남는다는 내용. ③이 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①신기술의 책 대체, ②작가들의 사실성 차이, ④미디어 환경 변화, ⑤독서의 어려움은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: Literature is, in essence, a testament to the enduring power of human creativity.
It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people across centuries and cultures.
Even as technology advances and media keeps changing, literature remains a timeless art form.
Its power lies in its ability to capture the complexity of human experience.
Through writing, authors explore deep emotions, delicate relationships, and the triumphs of the human spirit.
In its pages we recognize ourselves and understand the human condition more fully.
choices: Why Modern Media Will End the Age of Books
The Difficult Craft of Writing a Bestseller
Literature: A Timeless Bridge Across Time and the Human Heart
How Technology Changed the Way We Read
The Decline of Reading in a Digital World
title.explanation_ko: 문학이 시공간과 사람의 마음을 잇는 영원한 다리라는 핵심을 압축한 ③이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①책 시대의 종말, ②베스트셀러 집필 기술, ④기술과 독서 방식, ⑤독서의 쇠퇴는 초점이 아니다.

passage: Literature is a lasting proof of human creativity and expression.
It crosses time and space, linking us with the thoughts and feelings of people from all walks of life.
Even with new technologies and ever-changing media, it has kept its relevance as a timeless art form.
Much of its power comes from its ability to capture the complexity of human experience.
Authors use the written word to explore emotions, relationships, and the trials and triumphs of the human spirit.
Reading lets us see ourselves in others and understand the human condition more deeply.
choices: 문학은 기술 발전 앞에서 점차 그 의미를 잃어 가고 있다.
좋은 문학을 쓰려면 반드시 고전을 먼저 읽어야 한다.
문학은 시공간을 넘어 인간의 생각과 경험을 잇는 영원한 예술이다.
디지털 미디어는 문학보다 더 풍부한 감정을 전달한다.
작가는 자신의 경험만을 소재로 삼아야 진정성이 생긴다.
gist.explanation_ko: 문학이 시공간을 넘어 인간의 생각·경험을 잇는 영원한 예술이라는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①의미 상실, ②고전 선독, ④디지털 우위, ⑤자기 경험 한정은 요지와 반대이거나 무관하다.

passage: Literature, in its essence, is a testament to the enduring power of human creativity and expression.
It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people from all walks of life.
Although the rise of new technologies, literature has retained its relevance as a timeless art form.
One reason for literature's enduring power is its ability to capture the complexity of the human experience.
Through the written word, authors explore the depths of human emotion and the nuances of relationships.
Literature allows us to see ourselves reflected in the pages of a book and to gain a deeper understanding of the human condition.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ 뒤에 'the rise of new technologies'라는 명사구가 오므로 전치사 'Despite'가 와야 한다. 'Although'는 「주어+동사」 절을 이끄는 접속사라서 명사구만 데려오면 비문이 된다. 'Despite'로 고쳐야 한다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①testament을 잇는 전치사 to, ②분사구문 connecting, ④명사 ability를 수식하는 to부정사 to capture, ⑤see의 목적격 보어인 과거분사 reflected(우리가 비춰지는 것)는 모두 옳다.

passage: At its essence, literature is a testament to the fleeting power of human creativity.
It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people across cultures.
Despite new technologies, literature has retained its relevance as a timeless art form.
One reason for its power is its ability to capture the complexity of the human experience.
Through the written word, authors explore deep emotions and the nuances of relationships.
Literature lets us empathize with characters different from ourselves and understand the human condition.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 문학은 인간 창의성의 '지속되는(enduring)' 힘을 보여 주는 증거라는 흐름인데, 'fleeting(덧없는, 일시적인)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하다. enduring으로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②시공간을 '초월하다(transcends)', ③의미를 '유지하다(retained)', ④인간 경험의 '복잡함(complexity)', ⑤다른 인물에 '공감하다(empathize)'는 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Literature, at its core, proves the lasting power of human creativity and expression.
It transcends time and space, linking us with the thoughts and emotions of people across centuries.
Despite new technologies, it has kept its place as a timeless art form.
One reason for its power is its ability to __________.
Through writing, authors explore deep emotions, subtle relationships, and the struggles of the human spirit.
In a book's pages we recognize ourselves and understand the human condition more deeply.
choices: capture the complexity of the human experience
shorten the time people spend reading
blank.explanation_ko: 뒤 문장이 작가가 깊은 감정·관계·인간 정신의 분투를 탐구한다고 설명하므로, 빈칸에는 '인간 경험의 복잡함을 담아내는 능력'이 적절하다. ③이 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①기술 대체, ②과학적 예측, ④독서 시간 단축, ⑤감정 제거는 인간 경험을 담아낸다는 흐름과 맞지 않는다.

irrelevant.intro: Literature, in its essence, is a testament to the enduring power of human creativity and expression.
sentences: It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people across centuries and cultures.
Despite the rise of new technologies, literature has retained its relevance as a timeless art form.
Printing a single hardcover book today costs publishers far less than it did fifty years ago.
Through the written word, authors capture the complexity of human emotion, relationships, and the human spirit.
Literature thus lets us see ourselves in a book's pages and understand the human condition more deeply.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '문학이 시공간을 넘어 인간 경험을 담아내는 영원한 예술'이라는 흐름인데 ③ '오늘날 책 인쇄 비용이 더 싸졌다'는 무관한 내용이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②④⑤는 모두 문학이 인간의 생각·경험을 잇고 담아낸다는 주제로 연결된다.

order.given: Literature, in its essence, is a testament to the enduring power of human creativity and expression.

blocks.A: One reason for this enduring power is its ability to capture and convey the complexities of the human experience.
blocks.B: It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people across centuries and cultures.
blocks.C: Through the written word, then, authors explore deep emotion and relationships, letting us see ourselves reflected and understand the human condition.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(문학=창의성의 증거) 뒤 (B)가 시공간을 잇는다는 특성을, (A)가 'this enduring power'로 그 힘의 한 이유를 제시, (C)가 'Through the written word, then'으로 구체적 방식과 결론을 잇는다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'this enduring power'는 앞에서 힘을 언급한 (B) 뒤라야 하고, (C)의 then은 이유(A) 뒤 결론이라야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: One reason for this enduring power is its ability to capture the complexities of the human experience.

passage_marked.text: Literature is a testament to the enduring power of human creativity and expression.
It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people across cultures.
Despite new technologies, literature has retained its relevance as a timeless art form.
Through the written word, authors explore deep emotion, subtle relationships, and the human spirit.
In this way, literature lets us see ourselves reflected and understand the human condition more deeply.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 'this enduring power'의 한 가지 이유를 제시하며, 그 이유를 'Through the written word, authors explore ~'가 구체화한다. 문학이 영원한 예술로 남았다는 문장(③) 뒤, 작가가 감정을 탐구한다는 문장 앞에 와야 한다. ③이 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 다음 문장의 'Through the written word'가 무엇의 능력을 설명하는지 연결이 끊긴다.

passage: Literature is, at its core, proof of the lasting power of human creativity.
It transcends time and space, connecting us with people's thoughts and emotions across centuries.
Even as technology and media keep changing, it remains a timeless art form.
Its power comes from its ability to capture the complexity of human experience.
Through writing, authors explore deep emotion, relationships, and the human spirit.
So we see ourselves in its pages and understand the human condition more deeply.
summary.summary_template: Literature endures as a timeless art because it __(A)__ time and space and faithfully __(B)__ the complexity of human experience.
summary.explanation_ko: 문학은 시공간을 (A)crosses(가로질러) 사람을 잇고, 인간 경험의 복잡함을 충실히 (B)captures(담아내기에) 영원한 예술로 남는다. ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 crosses, (B)는 captures여야 한다. ①ends/②hides/④simplifies/⑤ignores는 본문과 반대이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 It + 동사 transcends + 목적어 time and space.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 문학은 우리가 우리 자신을 책의 페이지 속에 비친 모습으로 보게 해 준다.
writing.answer: Literature allows us to see ourselves reflected in the pages of a book.
writing.explanation_ko: allow + 목적어 us + to부정사 to see + 목적격 보어로 과거분사 reflected.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 새로운 기술의 등장에도 불구하고, 문학은 그 중요성을 유지해 왔다.
writing.answer: Despite the rise of new technologies, literature has retained its significance.
writing.explanation_ko: 전치사 Despite + 명사구 the rise of new technologies, 주절은 현재완료 has retained.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people from all walks of life.
writing.answer: 그것은 시간과 공간을 초월하여, 우리를 각계각층 사람들의 생각 및 감정과 연결해 준다.
writing.explanation_ko: transcends(초월하다), 분사구문 connecting(연결하면서), from all walks of life(각계각층의)에 유의한다.

writing.question: 다음 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 본문 흐름에 맞게 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Literature is a (A)___________ art form because it connects people across time and captures the (B)___________ of human experience.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 시대를 초월하는 '영원한(timeless)' 예술이며, (B) 인간 경험의 '복잡함(complexity)'을 담아낸다.
